questionText:
which word fills the blank in this research-library passage?

why exhaustion can throw everything off
exhaustion can affect mood, focus, appetite, stress _____, motivation, and daily rhythm.
poor sleep can make concentration harder.
poor sleep can increase daytime sleepiness.
sleep loss can affect glucose metabolism.
sleep loss can affect appetite-regulating hormones.
shorter sleep has been linked with changes in leptin and ghrelin, which help regulate hunger and fullness.
poor sleep can affect insulin sensitivity.
exhaustion can make small tasks feel unusually hard.
exhaustion can make emotions feel louder.
stress and exhaustion can reinforce each other.
exhaustion can make it harder to keep routines around meals, movement, hygiene, studying, work, or
